note: Phase 6 CHANGE TUTORIALS (owner's D2 pick): every major change ships a walkthrough here; the beat nags when a dashboard build has none. Newest first on the cockpit's Direction card.

tutorials.title: Creators live + connectors verification + your Direction card
steps: Cockpit → 🦾 Created by EXCAVA card: everything the Creators department made — each item is labeled, self-tested, and re-tested independently before its first use. 'Packages' = your term for multi-element bundles.
Connectors tab: a progress line now shows sandbox verification (your 'test-run everything' decision) marching through all 1,142 in CI batches; the tab shrinks to verified-only as results land (D5).

Cockpit → 🧭 Direction & tutorials card: state direction with the box (opens a prefilled 'EXCAVA: direction …' issue); EXCAVA's reading of each direction appears under it next beat — correct it by re-stating. This walkthrough list lives there too.
New goal G9 Agency/Orchestration on the North Star: scores how truly agentic the OS is (bus depth, hand-offs, autonomy under the gate).

tutorials.title: The living OS: fleet health, trace viewer, daemon feed
steps: Cockpit → 🛠 Fleet health: all 11 departments with their real workers, counters, and who's resting under backpressure.
Cockpit → 🚌 Live bus queue: click any task to open its REAL trace — including why a department was chosen over the runners-up.
Cockpit → 📡 OS events: the daemon feed — every pipeline lane's runs now become OS events, so EXCAVA sees the whole machine.
Floor bots are now real registered agents carrying their actual bus tasks (hover one). Safe/kill mode drops a maintenance overlay on the floor.

tutorials.title: You drive it: send box, kill switch, approval queue
steps: Cockpit → 🕹 You drive it: type a task, hit send — it opens a prefilled GitHub issue; CI queues it at owner rank and replies a receipt (works from your phone).
Same card: 🔴 kill / 🟡 safe / 🟢 run switches, and the priority-weights dial ('EXCAVA: weight access 95').
Cockpit → 🖊 Approval queue: the ONLY things waiting on you, each with a one-click approve link.

tutorials.title: Heavy Machinery cockpit + the OS spine underneath
steps: The cockpit became the home tab: living floor, task inbox, North-Star bars.
Underneath, Phase 0 built the file bus: departments pass work with validated hand-off docs; everything is traced in data/excava/.
